sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Daggerheart-style prompts that let players define safe, playable relationships before the first scene.

sections.body: Use during Session Zero, character introductions, and optional party-bond refresh beats.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use during Session Zero, character introductions, and optional party-bond refresh beats.
Offer one relationship prompt, then let the other player answer in their own words and keep only the part both players like.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
